tools.name: ledger_build
tools.description: Derive the double-entry ledger for one period in ONE currency from the invoice, credit note, deposit, expense, bank and asset stores, and register it. Nothing is written back. Free: 3 periods a month.

tools.name: period_delete
tools.description: Delete one built period from the register and give its free-tier slot back. Refused when a closed month's snapshot covers the period, and that month is named. No sibling book is touched.

tools.name: trial_balance
tools.description: Total the debits and the credits for a period and prove they are equal to the minor unit. When they are not, name the entries whose own legs do not add up and the source document behind each. Free and unlimited.

tools.name: ledger_lines
tools.description: List the ledger lines for a period, filtered by account, source server or document id, and date. Each line carries its debit, credit and bank_ref, the same field the Pro CSV lays out as a column. Free and unlimited.

tools.name: month_close
tools.description: List what a month leaves unposted or inconsistent, with its trial balance, then record the close as a snapshot; a later call names any drift. dry_run reports without writing. Pro.

tools.name: ledger_export_csv
tools.description: Return the period's ledger lines as RFC 4180 CSV, one row per leg, as a download link valid for one hour. Pro, but ledger_lines returns these same fields free and unlimited; this only lays them out as CSV columns.

tools.name: ledger_report
tools.description: Report a built period account by account: debits, credits, movement and closing balance, plus purchase commitments held as memos and the period's exceptions. Pro; ledger_lines gives the lines free.

tools.name: license_status
tools.description: Report this endpoint's licence state for your token as JSON: the product, the tier free or pro, why it is not Pro, and the checkout URL. Call it to explain a free-tier refusal. No arguments, nothing changes.

tools.name: license_activate
tools.description: Turn Pro on for this hosted connection using a key from checkout, keeping the data already stored under your current token. Pass key as MCPL1.<payload>.<signature>. A wrong or expired key changes nothing.
